consumer: mission::is_complete for the MGOAL_FIND_ITEM salvage contract, asking 'does the player have the required count of scrap?' to gate contract turn-in
scope: items reachable nearby per crafting_inventory() (carried plus nearby reachable stacks), not only the character's own carried items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — calls u.crafting_inventory() then tmp_inv.has_amount(item_id, item_count) (with a charges fallback) to compute the complete yes/no
divergence: The required scrap count is split: some carried, the rest sitting on an adjacent reachable tile. The engine predicate (crafting_inventory scope) returns complete, but a wrong answer derived from only carried/on-person items reports 'not yet' — gating turn-in incorrectly
